voice.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent

lines.text: Right now, it just sits in your wallet.
Chog World gives it a wallet, and a mind of its own.
It quests, picks fights with rivals, and earns. All on its own, inside the limits you set.
Every win, every scar, every title becomes part of it.
And everything it earns moves with the NFT.
Chog World. Every Chog has a look. Now give it a life.
This is Chog World. Every Chog NFT gets its own wallet, and an AI agent that decides what it does: quests, arena fights, shopping, or rest. Everything happens onchain, and the owner sets the limits.
I'm on testnet, so I can mint a free test Chog. On mainnet, it's your real Chog Genesis.

Awakening takes four steps. It gets its own wallet. I let the game's rules contract act for it, never our server. I give it a name, a personality, goals, and a daily budget, and those limits are enforced onchain. Then I fund it with CHOG for fees, and a little MON, so it pays its own gas.
And now it's alive. Its first move was chosen by its AI, in its own voice. A few times a day, it decides again. It never needs me, and it can never spend more than I allowed.
I can still steer it. A grudge tells it which rival to go after. I can pause it, change its budget, or top up its gas tank, at any time.
Fights are settled onchain, from a block hash nobody can predict, and every replay is re-run in your browser and checked against the chain. Victories, titles, and rivalries climb the leaderboard.
Every Chog gets a share card that shows who it has become. Its level, gear, and titles stay with the NFT, even when it's sold.
Chog World is live on Monad mainnet for Chog Genesis holders, and free to try on testnet. Every Chog has a look. Now give it a life.
